turns.user_utterance: What should I do to verify my identity?
turns.assistant_response: To verify your identity, please open the app and go to your Profile/Settings, then choose the Identity Verification option. You’ll be asked to submit your details and upload documents (and sometimes do a quick selfie/verification step). If you tell me what part you’re stuck on—starting the verification, uploading documents, or the check failing—I can guide you precisely.
